detail.longDescription: I have been moving off of large complex CMS platforms and I realized most of my sites could be static sites with a contact form. There are paid SaaS options out there, but miform is free self-hosted MIT! It is built on PocketBase https://pocketbase.io/ , so you get sqlite db, backups, email, API, logging and ability to extend it in any way you can imagine via hooks. I have considered combining it into one project with mistatic, so you get the static website hosting component, and the forms handling in one binary/container
